senderUmaAddress.description: UMA address of the sender from the sandbox

receiverUmaAddress.description: UMA address of the receiver (optional if customerId is provided)

customerId.description: System ID of the receiver (optional if receiverUmaAddress is provided)

receivingCurrencyCode.description: The currency code for the receiving amount

receivingCurrencyAmount.description: The amount to be received in the smallest unit of the currency (eg. cents)
